title: The Ash-Tithe of Alcaire
summary: Investigate the burning of wayside granaries between Alcaire and Weeping Giant, exposing a clandestine pact between fanatical Flame crusaders and the Skeffington witch-coven.

npcs.name: Almoner Celeste of Mara
npcs.greet: May Mara's hearth warm you, stranger—for someone is setting torches to every tithe-barn on the Alcaire road.
talk: The burghers of Alcaire leave birch-bundles at the forest edge to appease the Skeffington witches, while the Knights of the Flame burn any farmstead suspected of paying that toll.
Now the castle granary itself has been marked with ash-crosses. Speak with Castellan Renaud at Alcaire Castle before the town starves.

npcs.name: Castellan Renaud
npcs.greet: If you bring another petition from the Flame's inquisitors, save your breath. My garrison won't torch our own tenant villages.
talk: Preceptor Malo of the Flame claims the witches in Redwych Grotto poisoned the grain, yet his own riders were seen carrying sealed grain-casks toward Weeping Giant.
Question the miller's bailiff at Weeping Giant and see who truly profits from this crusade.

npcs.name: Bailiff Hugues
npcs.greet: Keep your voice down! The Flame's outriders camp on the ridge, and the hedge-crones listen from the willow roots.
talk: Preceptor Malo isn't burning the grain—he's trading it to Mother Griselda of the Skeffington Coven in Redwych Grotto in exchange for hex-jars to drive off the Ykalon border lords!
They cache the stolen tithes in Baldale Grotto and mix the blight-spores in Everhelm Hollow.

npcs.name: Sergeant Odile
npcs.greet: Well met! Castellan Renaud sent word by signal-fire that a free blade was tracking Malo's rogue banner.
talk: Malo has retreated into Everhelm Hollow with his fanatics to finish brewing the ash-blight.
Strike him down in the cavern and Alcaire's fields will breathe clean air again.

story_an_ash_cross: Almoner Celeste of Mara: Look upon the granary lintel—charred birch twigs bound with red thread, smeared over with oil from a knight's lamp.
Castellan Renaud: A witch's token painted with temple oil. Someone wants the burghers and the forest folk at each other's throats.
Almoner Celeste of Mara: Ride to Weeping Giant before another homestead is put to the torch.
story_an_grotto_bargain: Mother Griselda: The knight promised us ten wagons of winter wheat for every blight-pot we laid along the Ykalon boundary!
Bailiff Hugues: You poisoned the wells of poor tenants who left you butter and birch-charms every frost-moon!
Mother Griselda: Gold and prayers rot alike in the wet earth, little bailiff. Only fear keeps the axes out of our woods!
story_an_everhelm_pyre: Preceptor Malo: When the border fields are ash, the fearful flock to the sanctuary of the Flame—even if I must hire witches to light the kindling!
Sergeant Odile: You disgrace your spurs and Mara's peace, Malo! Lay down your torch!
Preceptor Malo: The pyre cleanses all doubts. Come and burn with the chaff!

quests.title: Ash-Crosses on the Granary
quests.summary: Examine the ash-marked granary in Alcaire with Almoner Celeste and consult Castellan Renaud at Alcaire Castle.
intro: Someone has marked the tithe-barns of Alcaire with charred birch crosses, sparking panic between the townsfolk and the Knights of the Flame.
Inspect the granary marks in Alcaire and report to Castellan Renaud at Alcaire Castle.
complete: Castellan Renaud suspects that Preceptor Malo's inquisitors are staging the witch-marks to seize tenant grain.

journal.start: Almoner Celeste asked me to inspect the ash-crosses in Alcaire and speak with Castellan Renaud at Alcaire Castle.
journal.done: Castellan Renaud directed me to Weeping Giant to trace the missing grain wagons.

quests.title: The Toll of Weeping Giant
quests.summary: Search the ruined way-station at Eaglefield Ruins and question Bailiff Hugues in Weeping Giant.
intro: Wagon ruts lead past Eaglefield Ruins toward the timber hamlet of Weeping Giant.
Inspect Eaglefield Ruins for discarded grain casks, then speak with Bailiff Hugues in Weeping Giant.
complete: Bailiff Hugues revealed that Preceptor Malo is secretly bartering stolen tithe-grain to Mother Griselda in Redwych Grotto.

journal.start: I should check Eaglefield Ruins for tracks of the missing grain wagons and speak to Bailiff Hugues at Weeping Giant.
journal.done: Bailiff Hugues exposed the bargain between Preceptor Malo and Mother Griselda in Redwych Grotto.

quests.title: Barter in Redwych Grotto
quests.summary: Enter Redwych Grotto, confront Mother Griselda of the Skeffington Coven, and destroy her blight-cauldrons.
intro: In the mossy sinkholes of Redwych Grotto, Mother Griselda brews crop-blight in exchange for the Flame's stolen wheat.
Enter Redwych Grotto and put an end to Mother Griselda's bargain.
complete: With Mother Griselda slain, ledger-tallies on her altar proved that Preceptor Malo has fortified Everhelm Hollow near Keep Noel.

journal.start: I must enter Redwych Grotto and defeat Mother Griselda of the Skeffington Coven.
journal.done: I defeated Mother Griselda and found Preceptor Malo's orders pointing to Keep Noel and Everhelm Hollow.

objectives.text: Confront Mother Griselda over the stolen tithe-grain

quests.title: The Ash-Brand's Reckoning
quests.summary: Meet Sergeant Odile at Keep Noel, storm Everhelm Hollow, and defeat Preceptor Malo the Ash-Brand.
intro: Preceptor Malo and his rogue crusaders are preparing to release the remaining blight-spores from Everhelm Hollow.
Join Sergeant Odile at Keep Noel, descend into Everhelm Hollow, and bring Malo to justice.
complete: Preceptor Malo's false crusade has been shattered, and the stolen grain wagons are being returned to the parishes of Alcaire.

journal.start: I must rally with Sergeant Odile at Keep Noel, then defeat Preceptor Malo inside Everhelm Hollow.
journal.done: I defeated Preceptor Malo in Everhelm Hollow and reported the victory to Almoner Celeste in Alcaire.
